question: What opposing relationships does the Goddess hold toward the ten-headed one?
premises: The Goddess cuts off the head of the ten-headed one.
The Goddess is described as the woman of the ten-headed one.
inference: The Goddess embodies both destructive power against the ten-headed one and intimate association with him.
uncertainties: The ten-headed one is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She is the cutter of the ten-headed one's head and the woman of the ten-headed one.
